basic_info.description: Charming 1-Bedroom Beachside Retreat - Steps from Ocean Beach! Discover the perfect blend of comfort and coastal living in this inviting 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment just moments from the breathtaking shores of Ocean Beach. Step into a bright and airy living space filled with natural light, seamlessly flowing into a well-appointed kitchen featuring modern appliances, including a convenient combination washer/dryer. The serene bedroom, complete with central heating, offers a cozy retreat after a day of exploring. Enjoy the ultimate beachside lifestylegrab a coffee or tea from the caf across the street, take a leisurely morning stroll along the shore, or unwind with a sunset picnic while soaking in the stunning ocean views. Located in a friendly neighborhood, you'll have easy access to local cafes, grocery stores, and public transit, making trips to downtown San Francisco effortless. This incredible offering includes 1-car garage parking, providing both convenience and peace of mind. Don't miss this rare opportunity to live by the beachschedule a viewing today!
